annotations.title: Google listing booking and order buttons

description: The BOOK / ORDER / RESERVE buttons on the brand’s Google Business Profile listing (Google calls them place action links). action "list" (default): each link’s type, url, whether it is preferred, who added it (the business or a booking partner) and whether apps may edit it. action "types": which link types Google offers THIS listing (depends on its category). action "create": placeActionType (APPOINTMENT, ONLINE_APPOINTMENT, DINING_RESERVATION, FOOD_ORDERING, FOOD_DELIVERY, FOOD_TAKEOUT, SHOP_ONLINE, SOLOPRENEUR_APPOINTMENT) + uri (https), optional isPreferred — added at once, publicly. action "update": name + any of uri, placeActionType, isPreferred, isDisabled (only on a partner’s link). action "delete": name. update and delete are called WITHOUT confirm first (they show the change and do nothing), then with confirm:true. One link per url and type; Google refuses a duplicate. 0 credits.

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user approved the exact change (update, delete)

isDisabled.description: update: switch a PARTNER’s link off or on

isPreferred.description: the preferred link for its type (one per type)

languageCode.description: types: language for the type names

locationId.description: which listing (locations/…), from list_business_locations — only needed when more than one is shared with this profile

name.description: update/delete: the link’s name (locations/…/placeActionLinks/…) or id, from list

placeActionType.description: create/update: APPOINTMENT, ONLINE_APPOINTMENT, DINING_RESERVATION, FOOD_ORDERING, FOOD_DELIVERY, FOOD_TAKEOUT, SHOP_ONLINE or SOLOPRENEUR_APPOINTMENT

uri.description: create/update: the https page where people book or order
